title: Implement a word frequency counter in Rust
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement word_count that splits text on whitespace and returns a HashMap<String, usize> with lowercased word frequencies, and top_words that returns the N most frequent words sorted by count desc then alpha asc.

required_artifacts: word_count splits on whitespace and lowercases
top_words returns top N words by count desc, alpha asc on ties
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
